findings.evidence: The active delta in openspec/changes/claude-external-advance/specs/model-routing/spec.md permits recovery only for a historical false violation recorded before receipts existed and requires self-attributed evidence to remain a violation. template/scripts/model_routing.py:889–949 checks the friction event, clean paths, ancestry, current origin/main and reflog timing, but never checks whether the incident predates receipts or whether existing receipts identify the delegated worktree. Consequently, a current self-attributed advance can fail record-claude-execution, produce the required friction event, and then pass recover-external-advance. Recovery replaces the postcheck baseline with that head (postcheck at lines 1728–1738), allowing subsequent recording to succeed without validating the rejected receipt chain.
findings.summary: Claude recovery is not restricted to historical violations from before receipts existed, so it can override current missing, broken or self-attributed receipt evidence.
